title: Expanding the WMT24++ Benchmark with Rumantsch Grischun, Sursilvan, Sutsilvan, Surmiran, Puter, and Vallader
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of a machine translation benchmark for the Romansh language and its regional varieties. The evaluation metrics and datasets are purely linguistic and domain-focused (News, Social, Literary, Speech) without any component related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
